svg.title: PDLA: Potential Forms & Applications
svg.desc: Schematic of the potential processing forms and medical applications of BioDegmer PDLA. Representative potential (cinnabar accent) - forms: Fiber, Film, Membrane, Block, Other processing forms, Monofilament, Braid, Mesh, Screws, etc., Hydroxyapatite; applications: Bone fixation device, Novel medical devices. Other potential is shown in grey. The dashed frame shows potential future applications (other processing forms to novel medical devices). Connecting lines show assumed relationships between forms and applications conceptually. The figure does not indicate processing or adoption track record, approval as a medical device, or suitability for any specific use.
